hero.intro: Hi, I'm Tu — a 3rd year Information Technology student at University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City. I'm passionate about building creative and intuitive digital experiences.

about.label: About
about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a tech-passionate student who constantly applies knowledge through real-world projects. With experience building dashboards, management apps, and web solutions, I keep learning and growing every day.

clothes.title: Clothes Shop DashBoard
clothes.description: A comprehensive fashion store management system featuring inventory tracking, order management, and intuitive revenue reporting.
clothes.result: Assists store owners in grasping real-time business performance. Optimizes inventory and stock processes, minimizing manual errors, thereby saving up to 30% of daily operational time.

coffee.title: Coffee Shop POS System
coffee.description: A POS system and business data dashboard dedicated to coffee shops, tracking revenue and top-selling products.
coffee.result: Streamlines the ordering and checkout process at the counter. Provides visual reports to easily analyze consumer trends, helping owners strategize ingredient stocking and menu adjustments for enhanced business efficiency.

parker.title: Parker The S-Accountant
parker.description: A smart personal finance application that helps users track daily income/expenses and set financial goals.
parker.result: Delivers a clear, comprehensive overview of personal finances. Supports spending habit analysis through visual charts, enabling users to cut unnecessary costs and achieve financial goals 20% faster.
